description: This file defines the class `Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Integer`, which represents an XML-RPC integer value within the Zend Framework's XML-RPC implementation. It includes a constructor to initialize the value with validation against PHP's maximum integer size, and a method to retrieve the integer value.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Integer
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC integer value in the Zend Framework. Extends `Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar` and provides methods for setting and retrieving integer values with validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with an integer value, throwing an exception if the value exceeds PHP's maximum integer.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value stored in the object.
